rationale: Local near-misses kept pointing at recurrent-tail float rescue. The current best export path already preserves tail Q/K in fp16 for recurrent blocks but leaves one recurrent V path quantized except for the final block. This patch extends fp16 rescue to `attn.c_v.weight` across all recurrent-tail blocks, which is a compact byte reallocation directly supporting the winning reverse-tail recurrence without changing training loop shape or adding new helpers.
title: Dual Recurrent-Tail V FP16 Rescue
